name: hotmail-checker
description: Hotmail cookie validator with inbox search - Telegram bot

ADMIN_IDS.description: Your Telegram numeric ID for admin commands (optional)

DATABASE_URL.description: Optional Postgres URL so per-user proxy lists survive restarts. Neon or Supabase free tier works. Leave blank to keep them in memory only.

PROXY_LIST_URL.description: Optional shared proxy list URL everyone falls back to

PROVIDERS.description: Enabled services: microsoft, netflix, instagram (comma separated). Use one alone for a single-service bot.

NF_LOGIN_LINKS.description: Generate one-click Netflix login links for live cookies

MAX_COOKIES_PER_JOB.description: Accounts per upload. 0 means no limit.

MAX_SEARCH_ACCOUNTS.description: Live accounts searched per job. 0 means every live account.
